name: sdd
description: Implement a superpowers plan or an OpenSpec change through subagents: /sdd:apply drives one unit controller per unit, with implementers and reviewers one layer down, and archives the run.

questionBudget.title: Question budget
questionBudget.description: How many refused questions one noask activation allows before its question budget is spent: a whole number from 1 to 99999; any other value counts as 6.

denialBudget.title: Denial budget
denialBudget.description: How many denials, the fence's included, one noask activation allows before its denial budget is spent: a whole number from 1 to 99999; any other value counts as 10.

fence.title: Fence
fence.description: While noask is on, deny before they run the outward calls the plugin names exactly, such as a push, each counted as a denial; off leaves them to the rule text.
